query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

messages.content: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

message.content:
In Massachusetts, the **maximum weekly unemployment benefit** is **$1,105 per week**, and you can collect it for **up to 30 weeks** if you qualify under current rules.[3][5]

A few details matter:

- Your actual weekly amount is generally about **50% of your average weekly wage**, capped at the state maximum.[5]
- Massachusetts says the benefit year can provide up to **30 times your weekly benefit amount** or **36% of your total base-period wages**, whichever applies under the calculation.[5]
- Older sources may show a lower maximum, because the cap is adjusted over time and has changed in recent years.[2][3][5]

If you want, I can also estimate **your approximate weekly benefit** based on your pay.
